args.evidence: TX power fell from ~+1.13 dBm avg to -2.33 dBm avg while TX bias rose from ~36 mA to 61 mA indicating laser degradation; RX power dropped in parallel from ~-12.4 dBm to -15.9 dBm with no added fibre loss on OTDR; OTDR events match as-built positions with no new loss or break. Alarms raised when RX fell below thresholds.
